CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioner is before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.651/2023 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 448, 504, 506 read with Section 149 of the IPC and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard Sri. Shakeer Abbas M., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha,
learned Addl.SPP., appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. M.R. Hiremathad and Sri. Ramakrishna N.,
learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3.
During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed a joint memo along with an affidavit.

The joint memo reads as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:44806 "JOINT MEMO 1.

The Petitioner has filed the present Petitionseeking setting aside of order dated 12/07/2023 wherein the trial Court was pleased to take cognizance of the alleged offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 354, 448, 504, 506 of I.P.C. and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act in C.C.No.651/2023 and all further proceedings thereto, pending on the file of the I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC at Harihar and consequently quash the Charge sheet filed in crime No.215/2022 dated 11/11/2022.
2.

The Respondent No.2 had lodged a Complaint dated 11/11/2022 before the Respondent No.1 Police alleging cruelty and dowry harassment which is came to be registered as Crime No.216/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A,
323, 354, 448, 504, 5061PC and Sections 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

sentences.text:
The dispute existed between the Petitioner and respondent No.2 is amicably settled and compromised before the Family Court, Davanagere in Crl.Misc.
No.216/2023.
The present settlement is arrived as per terms and conditions mentioned in the Joint Memo filed in Crl.Misc. No. 216/2023 before the family Court, Davanagere.
Thre is neo necessity of further continuance of proceedings as against the Petitioner as the dispute is settled between the Parties.
The dispute existed between the parties were purely personal in nature and no matter of public policy is involved.
4. The Petitioner and the respondent No.2 are divorced each other and not living as husband and wife.
Both the Petitioner and the Respondent No.2 also confirms that they do not have any claims or whatsoever at present or in future as against each other in terms of monetary or any other modes.
Further, both parties undertake not to interfere with the personal life of each other in future.
5. Therefore, under these circumstances the Respondent No.2 submits that she does not have any objection to allow the present Petition consequently quashing the trial Court.
proceedings.
6. The instant Memo is signed by the Parties on their own will and there is no coercion or undue influence.

NC: 2024:KHC:44806 Wherefore, it is humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow the present Petition andSet aside the order dated 12/07/2023 passed by the 1 Additional Civil Judge & JMFC at Harihar in C.C.No.651/2023, in so far as above Petitioners are concerned,
produced hereto as Annexure-A and consequently quash the Charge Sheet filed in Crime No.216/2022 dated 11-11-2022 by the Respondent Harihar Town Police for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 354, 448, 504, 506 read with 149 of the IPC and under Section 4 of the D.P.Act., produced hereto as Annexure-C."
4.
In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to accept the joint memo and close the proceedings against the petitioner in the subject petition.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i. Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. Proceedings in C.C.No.651/2023 pending before the I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Harihar, stands quashed qua the petitioner.
